page.alert: When an Opus source is sent as it is, the bitrate of the preset is the highest one it accepts before re-encoding it, not the quality it is streamed at. A higher preset only sounds better when the source carries that quality, such as a lossless file or an Opus file encoded at that bitrate.

subtext.text: Enumeration of audio quality settings for audio streams in telegram calls.

Represents the highest audio quality with a sample rate of 96000, 2 channels and the maximum Opus bitrate of 510 kbps, indistinguishable from a lossless source. It uploads about 3.8 MB per minute for each call.
Represents studio-quality audio with a sample rate of 96000, 2 channels and an Opus bitrate of 192 kbps.
Represents high-quality audio with a sample rate of 48000, 2 channels and an Opus bitrate of 128 kbps.
Represents medium-quality audio with a sample rate of 36000 and 1 channel.
Represents low-quality audio with a sample rate of 24000 and 1 channel.
Represents voice audio with a sample rate of 48000 and 1 channel, encoded like the official Telegram clients.
